_readme: Source of truth for every creative portfolio item. Edited by hand; read by build_images.py and build.py.
status: 'approved' = published on the public site. 'pending' = kept out of the public site (shown only in the local review preview, marked PENDING). 'rejected' = never shown.
Change an item to 'approved' ONLY when ownership, client/subject consent and usage rights are documented. Record who approved it and when in 'approved_by'.
Ownership is never inferred from a filename, watermark, EXIF data or folder.
After editing: python build_images.py   then   python build.py   (and python build.py --preview to refresh the review preview).
proposed: false = investigated and recorded, but not proposed for the portfolio (it never appears, even in the preview).
